what: Per-skin geometry expectations, each derived from one of the owner's own reference captures and each carrying the capture it came from.
why: Codex, 2026-10-27: per-skin historical expectations, not universal rules. Skins differ on purpose, and a rule like 'the hero must match the body column' reports a deliberate full-bleed layout as a defect. Every entry here names its evidence so the call can be checked.
authority: Sean, 2026-10-27: 'if it is in there it's the look that i want.' A disagreement between this file and a capture means this file is wrong.
how_a_figure_is_derived: Read the capture and measure the element in it.
Note the capture's usable width: 1920 minus a scrollbar where one is visible.
Render the skin at that same width and confirm the repaired figure reconciles with the capture.
Record both widths, so the arithmetic can be re-checked by anyone.

status_values.verified: Derived from a capture that was read, and reconciled against a render.
status_values.unverified: No capture read. NEVER treat as passing.
status_values.not_applicable: The skin has no such page or the element is absent by design.

page.capture_note: A scrollbar is visible, so the page had 1905 not 1920.
page.repair: AURORA 1.0.54 — the 680px reading column given to the title and the hero, which were siblings of the text column rather than inside it.
